src/warhammer40k_core/engine/catalog_pha.unchanged_work: Games with neither source selected register no phase-end healing binding. With a source selected, discovery scans its owning army units for the bound datasheet and checks those models' wounds. Healthy sources yield zero candidates but add one full snapshot of runtime state and history for the shared read-only guard. On a three-model healthy Shooting checkpoint, independent review measured six versus seven snapshots and +0.45 ms median over 13 alternating pairs. A registry-only repeat on a three-model healthy checkpoint measured three versus four snapshots and +0.388 ms median paired delta over 13 pairs, with zero candidates in both routes. These results apply to the measured discovery calls. The existing model-scoped healing path handles damaged sources.
